column1: # 031 PLAN-001 P1.4r mutgate spec. fix_id <TAB> target_file <TAB> sed_expr <TAB> test_cmd
# Run by evidence/P1.4r/p14r_mutgate.sh in a throwaway copy. `test` = ailang test
# src/core/ext/runtime.ail in the P1.4r workspace (p14r_check.sh: its own ailang.lock, so the
# lock trap cannot apply; 0 failed required); `e2e` = the end-to-end runner over P0.6's
# consumers (exit 0 and the PASS line required); `lint` = literal_defaults.py over the host
# context literals (static; for the literal sites inside effectful drivers no cheap test reaches).
# Every test_cmd is a script that logs to a file before grepping (no `cmd | grep -q` under pipefail).
# default verification = Passed -> red: the runtime's host literal (behavioural), the per-turn session literal, an rpc literal (static)

column3: s/^\t    verification: NotReached,$/\t    verification: Passed({ occurrence: "m", step: 0, command: "c", exit_code: Some(0), output: "", truncated: false, workspace_revision: None }),/
